titles: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

A survivor of the Holocaust, the mutant master of magnetism vows that mutants will never be persecuted as his family was. Once Charles Xavier's closest friend, he believes mutants must rule rather than hide, making him the X-Men's greatest adversary and sometimes their reluctant ally.

mcu.note: Not in the MCU yet. Ian McKellen is set to return as Magneto in Avengers: Doomsday (December 2026).

Hand-picked by Hitler and made into a living symbol of terror, Johann Schmidt becomes the Red Skull, the face of Nazi evil in World War II. Preserved into the present day, he remains Captain America's oldest and most hated enemy.
appearances: First appearance of the true Red Skull

mcu.actor: Hugo Weaving (Ross Marquand in Infinity War and Endgame)

To save his home planet Zenn-La, Norrin Radd agrees to serve the world-devourer Galactus as his herald, searching the universe for planets to consume. On Earth, he rebels against his master to protect humanity and is exiled here for years.

Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

origin: Scott Summers fires powerful beams of force from his eyes that he cannot turn off, so he must always wear a ruby-quartz visor or glasses. Charles Xavier's first student, he becomes the field leader of the X-Men.

mcu.note: Not in the MCU yet. James Marsden is set to return as Cyclops in Avengers: Doomsday (December 2026).

origin: A founding X-Man with telepathy and telekinesis, Jean Grey becomes host to the cosmic Phoenix Force, which makes her one of the most powerful beings in the universe. Her fall and sacrifice in "The Dark Phoenix Saga" is one of the most famous stories in comics.

titles: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

A Hollywood special-effects expert and stuntman, Quentin Beck decides he can win fame faster as a villain. Behind his fishbowl helmet, he uses illusions, hypnotic gas and holograms to fool Spider-Man and the public.

Exiled from Wakanda as a child, N'Jadaka grows up in America filled with anger at the nation that abandoned him. He returns as Erik Killmonger to challenge T'Challa for the throne and to use Wakanda's power on his own terms.

Serial killer Cletus Kasady shares a prison cell with Eddie Brock. When Venom's symbiote spawns an offspring, it bonds with Kasady and creates Carnage, more dangerous and unhinged than Venom ever was.
